visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a tabby cat peacefully sleeping, its eyes closed and ears slightly twitching. The cat is resting on a textured fabric surface, with soft indoor lighting. Yellow subtitles appear at the bottom. (2) The scene cuts to an outdoor porch area with wooden flooring. A woman with dark hair tied back, wearing a white t-shirt and denim shorts, is seen crouching and moving several large, light-colored plastic cat litter boxes. The background shows trees and the side of a building under natural daylight. (3) Two young girls, one in a pink top and one in a patterned beige shirt, are filmed walking down a set of light wood-colored stairs with white railings. They look cheerful and expectant. (4) Back outdoors, the two girls are crouching on the ground, using green and yellow plastic scoops to sift through cat litter in yellow trays. They are focused on the task, occasionally looking at each other or the camera. (5) The woman is shown helping the girls pour used litter from a large tray into a clear plastic bag. The girls are holding the bag open, showing concentrated facial expressions. (6) The scene transitions to the girls washing the litter boxes in yellow basins filled with soapy water. They are using sponges to scrub the sides, with white bubbles visible. The woman is nearby, washing a larger white container. The atmosphere is playful and active. (7) A close-up shows the younger girl in the pink top vigorously scrubbing, then standing up and walking towards the woman. The woman looks at her with an exaggerated expression of surprise. (8) The video concludes with a solid pink screen featuring white text logos.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a family chore—cleaning cat litter boxes—transformed into a playful and educational activity for young children. It highlights the 'Lady Flavor' brand within a warm, domestic lifestyle context, emphasizing responsibility and family bonding.
